source.title: New WST Leader (October 2019)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Team Leader. Philippe Virouleau will become the new Leader of the WCA Software Team (WST). Philippe was already working as a member of the WST.

Philippe was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Jeremy Fleischman for the work he has done for the WST, and wish Philippe best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

The new Leader will be promoted immediately. Philippe was the only applicant and his candidacy document can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NBsDZQbn5fsM5kz9TVKJ7Yv9JsDQ9Te1).

translation.title: WCA 软件团队新负责人（2019 年 10 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Philippe Virouleau 将成为 WCA 软件团队（WST）的新负责人。Philippe 此前已是 WST 成员。

按照 WCA 委员会与团队[动议 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节的规定，WCA 董事会选定 Philippe，并由现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票通过。

感谢 Jeremy Fleischman 为 WST 所做的工作，祝 Philippe 在新的岗位上工作顺利。

新负责人将立即就任。Philippe 是唯一的申请者，他的申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NBsDZQbn5fsM5kz9TVKJ7Yv9JsDQ9Te1)查看。
